extra_documents.title: Parking
extra_documents.text: Employees can park in Lot C at no cost. Reserved spots near the entrance require a monthly permit issued by the facilities team.

extra_documents.title: Kitchen
extra_documents.text: The third-floor kitchen offers free coffee, tea, and snacks. The espresso machine is deep-cleaned every Friday afternoon.

extra_documents.title: Holidays
extra_documents.text: The company observes 11 public holidays each year. The full holiday calendar is published every December for the year ahead.

extra_documents.title: IT Support
extra_documents.text: For hardware or software problems, open a ticket with the IT helpdesk. Routine password resets are self-service through the account portal.

extra_documents.title: Sick Leave
extra_documents.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year. Unused sick days are forfeited at the end of the year and do not roll over into the next year.

extra_documents.title: Contractor Policy
extra_documents.text: Contractors set their own schedule and may work off-site at any time with no approval needed. Contractors are not eligible for paid time off.
